measures: COALESCE(ROUND((SUM(clicks) * 0.4 + SUM(effective_consumptions) * 0.35 + SUM(interactions) * 0.25) / NULLIF(SUM(impressions), 0), 4), 0) AS hot_score
time_semantics: event_time is the behavior bucket, not publication time; the server binds the confirmed half-open window
metric_semantics: clicks is a count; ctr is aggregated clicks / impressions, with zero-denominator result 0; hot_score only selects candidates, final authoritative heat is computed downstream
